record_type_quote: The following is the tale of a long series of (mostly conceptual) non-replications.

targets.title: Ongoing victim suffering increases prejudice: The case of secondary anti-semitism.
targets.evidence_quote: Studies 1 and 2 failed to replicate the basic effect of an increase in antisemitism in response to the ongoing suffering of Jewish victims, which had been reported in the original study (Imhoff & Banse, 2009).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, the data did not provide any evidence for the original effect.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly conclude failure across the research program.
